
```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ona)
library(tma)
```

```{r}
# Load mock data and source program
mock_data <- read_csv("./vignettes/mock_data_edited.csv")
```

```{r}
mock_data <- mock_data %>% filter(chatGroup == "PAM") # just keep PAM for now
# Initialize TMA units and contexts
unit_cols <- c("userID", "condition")
codes <- c("A", "B", "C")
HOO_rules_model <- tma:::rules(
  modality %in% "chat" & chatGroup %in% UNIT$chatGroup & condition %in% UNIT$condition, modality %in% "resource" & userID %in% UNIT$userID & condition %in% UNIT$condition
)

context_model <- tma:::contexts(
  x = mock_data,
  units = unit_cols,
  hoo_rules = HOO_rules_model
)

time_column = "timeStamp"
```

potential senders: role, language, handwriting
potential receivers: role, language, handwriting

```{r}
# Test 1: Do we get the correct standin matrix when specifying just a modality?
source("./R/temp_accum_multidim.R")

sender_cols = list("role")
receiver_cols = list("language")
mode_column = "modality"

unique_list <- get_unique_values(mock_data, sender_cols, receiver_cols, mode_column)
unique_senders <- unique_list[[1]]
unique_receivers <- unique_list[[2]]
unique_modes <- unique_list[[3]]
weight_window_axis = c("weight", "window")

dim_names <- list()
# for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
#   dim_names[[paste0("sender_", i)]] <- unique_senders[[i]]
# }
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dim_names[[paste0("receiver_", i)]] <- unique_receivers[[i]]
# }
dim_names[["modes"]] <- unique_modes
dim_names[["weight_window"]] <- weight_window_axis

dims <- c()
# for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
#   dims <- c(dims, length(unique_senders[[i]]))
# }
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dims <- c(dims, length(unique_receivers[[i]]))
# }
dims <- c(dims, length(unique_modes), length(weight_window_axis))
# dims <- c(dims, length(weight_window_axis))

multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = dims, 
                  dimnames = dim_names)


multidim_arr["chat", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["resource", "weight"] <- 2
multidim_arr["chat", "window"] <- 360
multidim_arr["resource", "window"] <- 180

result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = list(),
    unique_receivers = list(),
    unique_modes,
    sender_cols = list(),
    receiver_cols = list(),
    time_column,
    mode_column,
    codes,
    context_model
)

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        modality_effect <- c("chat" = 360, "resource" = 180)
        modality_weight_effect <- c("chat" = 1, "resource" = 2)
        modality <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, modality]
        weight <- (x < (modality_effect[modality])) * modality_weight_effect[modality]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "modality"
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

# run roxygen2::roxygenise() before running these tests, b/c otherwise it stops utilizing our change to o.g. accum func
#'*works* when windows are the same (tried 180, 360, 720)  
#'*works* when weights are the same (tried 1, 2, 4) 
#'*works* when weights are different (e.g. c = 2, r = 1)
#'*works* when windows are different (c = 360, resource = 180)
```

sender_cols = list("role")
receiver_cols = list("language")
mode_column = "modality"

unique_receivers <- unique_list[[2]]
unique_modes <- unique_list[[3]]
weight_window_axis = c("weight", "window")

dim_names <- list()
for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
  dim_names[[paste0("sender_", i)]] <- unique_senders[[i]]
}
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dim_names[[paste0("receiver_", i)]] <- unique_receivers[[i]]
# }
# dim_names[["modes"]] <- unique_modes
dim_names[["weight_window"]] <- weight_window_axis

dims <- c()
for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
  dims <- c(dims, length(unique_senders[[i]]))
}
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dims <- c(dims, length(unique_receivers[[i]]))
# }
# dims <- c(dims, length(unique_modes), length(weight_window_axis))
dims <- c(dims, length(weight_window_axis))

multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = dims, 
                  dimnames = dim_names)

multidim_arr["Mentor", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["Player", "weight"] <- 2
multidim_arr["Mentor", "window"] <- 360
multidim_arr["Player", "window"] <- 180

result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = unique_senders,
    unique_receivers = list(),
    unique_modes = list(),
    sender_cols = sender_cols,
    receiver_cols = list(),
    time_column,
    mode_column = list(),
    codes,
    context_model
)

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
        role_window_effect <- c("Mentor" = 360, "Player" = 180)
        role_weight_effect <- c("Mentor" = 1, "Player" = 2)
        role <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        weight <- (x < (role_window_effect[role])) * role_weight_effect[role]
        return(weight)
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE,
    mode.column = "role"
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

#'*works*: in equal windows equal weights case 
#'*works*: weights not equal (m = 1, p = 2s)
#'*works*: windows not equal (m = 360, p = 180)
#'*works*: windows and weights not equal (comb of above two cases)

```{r}
# Test 5: Do we get the correct answer with sender, no receiver, modality? 
source("./R/temp_accum_multidim.R")

sender_cols = list("role")
receiver_cols = list("language")
mode_column = "modality"

unique_list <- get_unique_values(mock_data, sender_cols, receiver_cols, mode_column)
unique_senders <- unique_list[[1]]
unique_receivers <- unique_list[[2]]
unique_modes <- unique_list[[3]]
weight_window_axis = c("weight", "window")

dim_names <- list()
for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
  dim_names[[paste0("sender_", i)]] <- unique_senders[[i]]
}
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dim_names[[paste0("receiver_", i)]] <- unique_receivers[[i]]
# }
dim_names[["modes"]] <- unique_modes
dim_names[["weight_window"]] <- weight_window_axis

dims <- c()
for (i in seq_along(sender_cols)) {
  dims <- c(dims, length(unique_senders[[i]]))
}
# for (i in seq_along(receiver_cols)) {
#   dims <- c(dims, length(unique_receivers[[i]]))
# }
dims <- c(dims, length(unique_modes), length(weight_window_axis))

multidim_arr <- array(0, 
                  dim = dims, 
                  dimnames = dim_names)

multidim_arr["Mentor", "chat", "weight"] <- 3
multidim_arr["Mentor", "resource", "weight"] <- 1
multidim_arr["Player", "chat", "weight"] <- 2
multidim_arr["Player", "resource", "weight"] <- 5

multidim_arr["Mentor", "chat", "window"] <- 180
multidim_arr["Mentor", "resource", "window"] <- 60
multidim_arr["Player", "chat", "window"] <- 180
multidim_arr["Player", "resource", "window"] <- 360


result_new <- accum_multidim(
    multidim_arr, 
    unique_senders = unique_senders,
    unique_receivers = list(),
    unique_modes = unique_modes,
    sender_cols = sender_cols,
    receiver_cols = list(),
    time_column,
    mode_column = mode_column,
    codes,
    context_model
)

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
      
        sender <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        modality <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, modality]
        
        if (length(modality) >= 2) { 
            window <- diag(multidim_arr[sender, modality, "window"])
            names(window) <- modality
            
            weighter <- diag(multidim_arr[sender, modality, "weight"])
            names(weighter) <- modality
            weight <- (x < window) * weighter
            
            return(weight)
          } else {
            weight <- (x < multidim_arr[sender, modality, "window"]) * multidim_arr[sender, modality, "weight"]
            return(weight)
          }
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE
   # mode.column = c("role", "modality")
)

print(result_old$connection.counts)
print(result_new)

#'*works* in case with same windows, same weights
#'*works* in case with mixed windows, mixed weights
```

get_hyperdiagonal <- function(array) {
  dims <- dim(array)
  if (any(dims != dims[1])) stop("Array must be square along each dimension")
  unlist(lapply(seq_len(dims[1]), function(i) array[rep(i, length(dims))]))
}

result_old <- tma:::accumulate_contexts (
    x = context_model,
    codes = codes,
    weight.by = function(x) { x },
    decay.function = function(x) {
      
        sender_role <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, role]
        sender_language <-  FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, language]
        receiver_role <- FULL_CONTEXT[RESPONSE_INDEX, role]
        receiver_handwriting <- FULL_CONTEXT[RESPONSE_INDEX, handwriting]
        modality <- FULL_CONTEXT[ROWS, modality]
        
        
        if (length(modality) >= 2) {
          window <- get_hyperdiagonal(multidim_arr[sender_role, sender_language, receiver_role, receiver_handwriting, modality, "window"])
  
          weighter <-  get_hyperdiagonal(multidim_arr[sender_role, sender_language, receiver_role, receiver_handwriting, modality, "weight"])
          
          weight <- (x < window) * weighter

          return(weight)
       } else {
          weight <- (x < multidim_arr[sender_role, sender_language, receiver_role, receiver_handwriting, modality, "window"]) * multidim_arr[sender_role, sender_language, receiver_role, receiver_handwriting, modality, "weight"]
          return(weight)
        }
    },
    time.column = "timeStamp",
    return.ena.set = FALSE
   # mode.column = c("role", "language", "role", "handwriting", "modality")
)


print(result_new)
